# Toast props

## Per-toast options — `add` / `update` / `promise`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `ComponentType<{ className?: string; }>` | — | Icon component rendered in the toast's leading slot. Receives a `className` prop pre-populated with default sizing (`size-5 shrink-0 self-start`), merged with `iconClassName` if provided. Pass a lucide/heroicons component directly, or a wrapper for fully custom rendering. |
| `iconClassName` | `string` | — | Extra classes applied to the rendered `icon`. Use this for color (e.g. `text-success-text`) without having to wrap the icon component. |
| `className` | `string` | — | Extra classes merged into `Toast.Root`'s className. Use this for per-toast styling like accent bars, borders, or background tints — typically driven off `type`. |
| `dismissible` | `boolean` | `false` | When `true`, renders a close (×) button on this toast. Clicking it dismisses the toast via Base UI's `Toast.Close`. Passing `onClose` implicitly enables this, so you only need to set `dismissible` when you want the button without a side-effect handler. `dismissible: false` hides the button even when `onClose` is set. |
| `onClose` | `() => void` | — | Called once when the toast closes, whichever way (close button, timeout, swipe, Escape with focus inside the toast, `manager.close`). Passing this prop also implicitly renders the close button (no need to also set `dismissible`). |
| `closeProps` | `Omit<ToastCloseProps, "ref"> & RefAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>` | — | Props for the built-in close button. `className` merges after the library classes; `aria-label` overrides `labels.close`; `event.preventBaseUIHandler()` in `onClick` keeps the toast open. Renders no button on its own: set `dismissible` or `onClose` to show it. |

## Toast.Viewport

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `labels` | `Partial<ToastLabels>` | — | Replaces the built-in English strings, e.g. to translate them. Keys you leave out keep the default from `DEFAULT_TOAST_LABELS`. `aria-label` takes precedence over `labels.viewport`, and a toast's `closeProps["aria-label"]` over `labels.close`. |

## Labels

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `viewport` | `string` | `"Notifications"` | Name of the `Toast.Viewport` region. |
| `close` | `string` | `"Close"` | Name of the close button of a dismissible toast. |
